prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your needs (emergency repair vs. planned replacement, budget, warranty, same-day availability, etc.). That said, here’s a practical way to find the best AC repair company in Houston and a few well-known options to consider.

Quick starter list (widely used in Houston)
- John Moore Services — long-established, local company with full HVAC/plumbing/electrical services.
- ARS / Rescue Rooter (Rescue Rooter | ARS) — national company with local Houston crews and 24/7 emergency service.
- One Hour Heating & Air (local franchise) — franchise network with emphasis on punctual service and repair guarantees.

How to choose the best company for your situation
- Verify credentials: check contractor registration with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) and ask for proof of insurance.
- Technician qualifications: look for NATE-certified techs (North American Technician Excellence).
- Read recent reviews: check Google, Yelp, BBB for recent customer experiences — focus on repairs similar to yours.
- Warranties & guarantees: ask about parts and labor warranties and any satisfaction guarantees.
- Transparent pricing: get written estimates, ask if diagnostic fees apply and how they’re applied if you proceed with repair.
- Availability: confirm emergency/after-hours service if you need it now.
- Ask for references: especially for larger jobs or replacements.

Questions to ask a contractor before hiring
- Are you licensed/registered with TDLR and insured?
- Are your technicians NATE-certified?
- What does the written estimate include?
- What are the parts and labor warranties?
- Do you charge a diagnostic fee and is it credited toward repair?
- Can you provide recent references or online review links?

Red flags
- Unsolicited door-to-door offers or high-pressure sales.
- No written estimate or contract.
- Requests for full cash up front.
- No proof of license/insurance or unmarked vehicles.

Want me to look up top-rated AC repair companies near you? If so, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you need emergency service. I can pull current reviews and short contact options.
